name: Sea Trader
author: ulfendk
description: Shows how many of your Sea Trader ships need orders, notifies you when a decision comes up, and opens the game as a floating window.

barWidget.description: Ships waiting for orders. Left click opens the game, right click refreshes.

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Seconds between status checks. Server URL and token live in ~/.config/sea-trader/config.
